author: Singh
review: I stayed at Hotel Eden, Karwar for two nights and had a great experience. The rooms were spacious, clean, and well-equipped, the service was quick and helpful, and the food, including the complimentary breakfast, was excellent. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone visiting the city.

author: Aayaz vk
review: I stayed at Eden Hotel recently and had a great experience. The staff were polite and professional, the service was excellent, the rooms were clean, and the overall atmosphere was very welcoming.

author: Narayan kamath
review: I returned to Hotel Eden for a five-day stay and it exceeded my expectations. The Club room was clean, spacious, and well maintained, housekeeping was excellent, the staff were outstanding, and the Tulip restaurant has improved a lot. Overall, it is a great place to stay for business and events.
